parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic. It is typically rectangular with a slanted flap for inserting waste.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the trashcan opening to contain odors and maintain cleanliness. It often includes a swinging or push flap for easy waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or the flap can swing inward and outward when pushed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a tall, rectangular container designed to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the main storage compartment for trash, supporting the lid and containing the waste bag.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary and does not move during normal use, though it can be lifted or carried when emptying.
